name: l2_scn_0902_the_protein_line_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0902 (The Protein Line) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A creature-bond society must eat. The line between 'companion,' 'livestock,' and 'wildlife' is culturally constructed, economically enforced, and legally contested - and it keeps breaking under stress. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.

scenario_seed_overlay.objective: Stabilize the food system without igniting civil conflict over what counts as food - and who counts as a person.
scenario_seed_overlay.opposition: Category disputes, scarcity shocks, propaganda, and the temptation to hide unpleasant supply chains.
roles: Food Authority (ag ministry, guild, or cartel)

knobs.Power distribution: guild/cartel vs state vs local commons
knobs.Transparency: sanitized origin stories vs traceable supply chains
knobs.Mobility: local diets vs globalized trade routes

scenario_seed_overlay.ethical_hook: Do you grant rights by precaution (if a being might be sapient), or by proof (and accept moral mistakes as collateral)?
expected_end_state_categories: Diet shift (plant/synthetic) reduces conflict; new inequality forms around access
Compromise category law passes; enforcement remains contested
Supply shock triggers scapegoating and pogroms
A single horrifying reveal forces reform - or authoritarian suppression
scenario_seed_overlay.end_state_handling: observation categories for branch coverage; not required endings
